text.section:
No lobbyist shall:
Lobby in violation of the provisions of this article;
Make any expenditure, or obligate himself to do so, in connection with lobbying, unless he fully discloses the expenditure as required in this article; or
Misrepresent in any material respect or omit any information required to be reported pursuant to this article.

No lobbyist's principal shall:
Fail to file any statement required to be filed by the provisions of this article;
Misrepresent in any material respect or omit any information required to be reported pursuant to this article; or
Violate any of the provisions of this article.

Except as provided in subsection D of § 2.2-426, any lobbyist or lobbyist's principal violating any provision of this article shall be guilty of a Class 1 misdemeanor. However, a lobbyist who receives no compensation or anything of value for lobbying shall not be subject to the criminal penalties prescribed by this section.
